body:
PR Summary by Qodo

Document lead recovery after container restarts 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Give leads a recovery procedure for stopped agents and commands after container restarts.
>• Preserve completed work and exclude restart interruptions from failed-attempt counts.
>• Record B-7’s completion and explain the restart status to owners.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD Notice["Restart notice"] --> Room["Read room"] --> Worktrees["Inspect worktrees"] --> Choice{"Transcript available?"} --> Resume["Resume agent"] --> Checks["Rerun checks"] --> Status["Post STATUS"] Choice --> Fresh["Brief fresh agent"] --> Checks ```
High-Level Assessment

>The documentation-only protocol fits an event that wakes the lead while leaving the room, lease, and state intact. Changing room.py or automatically resetting state would add risk without addressing the stopped subagents and commands the lead must assess.
Files changed (5) +80 / -5

Documentation (5) +80 / -5
CHANGELOG.mdRecord M6e restart recovery +1/-0
>Record M6e restart recovery > >
>• Adds a release note describing the lead’s recovery procedure and clarifying that a container restart does not count as a failed attempt.
>
> >CHANGELOG.md
LEAD.mdDefine the lead’s post-restart procedure +20/-3
>Define the lead’s post-restart procedure > >
>• Directs the lead to read the room, inspect stopped agents’ worktrees, resume or replace agents, rerun interrupted waits, and post a status without repeating completed work. Clarifies attempt accounting and links the delegation rule to this procedure.
>
> >LEAD.md
BUILD-STATE.mdTrack M6e and mark B-7 complete +4/-2
>Track M6e and mark B-7 complete > >
>• Adds the M6e milestone and assumption A-13, connects finding W to the new spec, and records B-7 as done.
>
> >docs/design/BUILD-STATE.md
m6e-restarts.mdSpecify the M6e restart-recovery scope +54/-0
>Specify the M6e restart-recovery scope > >
>• Documents what survives and stops during a container restart, the intended lead procedure, and the work excluded from this docs-only change.
>
> >docs/design/m6e-restarts.md
troubleshooting.mdExplain restart statuses to owners +1/-0
>Explain restart statuses to owners > >
>• Adds a troubleshooting row explaining that a restart status requires no owner action because the room, lease, and state remain unchanged.
>
> >docs/manual/troubleshooting.md

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
